name: envelope
description: All your email accounts in one inbox, shared with your agents. Envelope connects to the mailboxes you already have, so agents can read OTPs, search and reply across accounts, run rules, and draft for your approval.

ENVELOPE_AGENT_TOKEN.title: Envelope agent token
ENVELOPE_AGENT_TOKEN.description: Bearer token from `envelope agent create <name>`. Printed once at creation. Required for MCP startup; never commit the value.
